decision.blocker: STRICT_ED25519_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE remains real until qualified provisioning and conformance pass.
decision.authority: Current continuous lane C01 and continuity-agent delegated items 3-7 permit bounded reference environment remediation. The historical pipelined available-library/no-download restriction was a conservative worker interpretation, not expressly adopted by current continuous task. This decision clarifies environment preparation only; it changes no frozen protocol or strict verification predicate.
decision.allowed_preparation: Obtain the exact official libsodium1.0.22 release source archive, Windows MSVC archive, detached signatures and upstream public signing key into a dedicated repository .cache subdirectory. No global install, PATH mutation, production dependency, or committed downloaded source/binaries.
decision.verification_before_use: Verify exact release API SHA256 and detached GPG signatures with existing Git-bundled gpg in a dedicated cache homedir. Read the maintainer public key from official installation documentation, record its full fingerprint and verified signing fingerprint. Fail closed on any missing/mismatched verification. Do not fetch keys from arbitrary keyservers.
decision.dependency_trust_boundary: Upstream package-signing key authenticates this development dependency only; it is not a new Delta validator, deployment, consensus, or governance trust root.
decision.implementation_boundary: After archive authentication, select one x64 release DLL by explicit resolved path. Record its SHA256, upstream release tag/commit, archive path, architecture, build variant, reported sodium version and exact exported APIs. Use bounded ctypes buffers in quarantined reference only. No permissive cryptography fallback or custom curve implementation.
required_conformance: Strict canonical nonidentity prime-order checks for both A and Rpoint through crypto_core_ed25519_is_valid_point; reject S >= L before detached verification.
Public deterministic known-answer signature vectors; exact K/E/R/V/M/G canonical bytes and signable preimage.
Negative A/Rpoint/S/context/preimage/tamper and malformed-length vectors with explicit expected reject behavior.
No acceptance skipped because the backend is unavailable; STOP with exact diagnostic if provisioning or required APIs fail.
decision.history: Preserve original STOP evidence immutably. Add new remediation/conformance evidence rather than rewrite the historical outcome.
decision.limitations: Vendor-authenticated package identity and local conformance are not a reproducible-build attestation, proof of binary correctness, production key-custody qualification, or Formal GO.
decision.resume: Resume ISC-S16-C01 on its API-assigned branch; incorporate only this new coordinator handoff from canonical. Existing W1 accepted commit remains separately pinned. Do not merge unrelated code or reimport the graph.
